title: Macro Defect Inspection - Extra Pattern Detection on Archer 700
subtitle: Post-Anneal Quality Validation for 3nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Amir Patel

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Archer 700 system to detect and classify Extra Pattern defects during post-anneal inspection at the 3nm technology node. The test is conducted at Dresden Fab 3 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Extra Pattern defects that are critical to yield at the 3nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Archer 700 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Archer 700
- Inspection Type: Macro Defect Inspection
- Target Defect: Extra Pattern
- Process Step: Post-Anneal
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 3nm
- Fab Location: Dresden Fab 3

This test case applies to all Archer 700 systems deployed at Dresden Fab 3 for post-anneal monitoring in the 3nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Archer 700
Software Version: v12.6.211
Recipe: MACRO_DEFECT_INSPECTION_3nm_POST_ANNEAL
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: Low (68 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.5μm
Edge Exclusion: 5mm
Sampling Plan: 9-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Archer 700 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Macro Defect Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Extra Pattern defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 3nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 100 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 97% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±1.3% for Macro Defect Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.98 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-07-29
Wafers Tested: 8
Total Defects Found: 941
Defect Density: 299.53 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 4.1%
Capture Rate: 88.6%
Test Duration: 187 minutes
System Uptime: 96.7%

Result Classification: PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Archer 700 demonstrated excellent performance in detecting Extra Pattern at the 3nm node.

b) The capture rate requires optimization of the detection algorithm.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Edge-zone defect detection showed improved performance compared to previous revision.

e) The system successfully integrated with the factory automation host.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Test passed all acceptance criteria.
